goal: Reduce the plane-specific positivity blocker by showing that positivity would descend automatically if the projected block were exhibited as a compression of a branch-scope certified positive host operator.

host_certificate.object: A = K_total + m0^2 I with Weyl-margin certificate from QW-2186

conditional_bridge.lemma: If A is positive on the certified branch-scope class and A_proj = P A P|(Ran P), then positivity descends to the projected block.
